dataset.description: This dataset contains High-Resolution Mass Spectrometry (HRMS) data generated during the analytical characterization of samples collected in the study. The data include raw and processed mass spectra used to identify and/or quantify chemical compounds present in experimental samples.Data were acquired using high-resolution mass spectrometry instrumentation under standardized analytical conditions to ensure reproducibility and comparability across samples. Quality control samples and blanks were included to monitor instrument performance and detect potential contamination or signal drift.

format:
The project will generate and re-use analytical data related to the quantification of tetrodotoxin (TTX) using High-Resolution Mass Spectrometry (HRMS).
Generated data include raw HRMS files (instrument-specific formats) and processed spectral data for TTX detection and quantification. Quantitative results (e.g., peak areas and concentrations) will be stored in open formats such as .csv or .xlsx. Calibration curves, quality control data, and validation outputs will also be produced in tabular formats (.csv/.xlsx).
All data will be managed according to FAIR principles, with preference for open and interoperable formats (e.g., mzML, CSV) to ensure accessibility and reuse.

distribution.available_until: No, the data will be made publicly available without embargo upon publication.

dmp.description: The project uses high-resolution analytical chemistry techniques, namely Ultra-High Performance Liquid Chromatography coupled with High-Resolution Tandem Mass Spectrometry (UHPLC-HR-MS/MS), to detect, identify and quantify TTXs in marine samples, producing complex datasets including raw spectral files, processed data and method parameters and calibration data.
